headline: 672 contracts catalogued across 13 chains from official docs address registry; 18 core/admin Stake DAO contracts identified plus 654 protocol/locker/strategy/votemarket entries

findings.text: D1: Etherscan search result confirmed SDT token at 0x73968b9a57c6E53d41345FD57a6E6ae27d6CDB2F with Stake DAO label. Block-explorer name-tag searches for other chains (arbiscan, basescan, optimistic.etherscan.io, polygonscan, lineascan, fraxscan, sonicscan) were covered transitively via the official docs address table which links each address to its chain explorer.

D2: Official deployments page at https://docs.stakedao.org/addresses lists 672 contracts, synced from the offchain-registry GitHub repo. Covers Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BSC, Fraxtal, Gnosis, Linea, Optimism, Polygon, Sonic, Taiko, zkSync Era, BNB. Core Stake DAO contracts include SDT, VESDT, VLSDT, TIMELOCK (48h delay), TREASURY, PROXY_ADMIN, GOVERNANCE, DEPLOYER, ALL_MIGHT, ALL_MIGHT_V2, LAPOSTE, BOTMARKET, and per-protocol locker/strategy/votemarket contracts.

D3: Audit GitHub repo at https://github.com/stake-dao/audits lists 11 audit reports: Staking v2 (Omniscia May 2025, Trust Security Apr 2025, Pashov Aug 2025, Omniscia Sep 2025), OnlyBoost (Trust Security Feb 2024 x2, Zach Obront Nov 2023), Votemarket V2 (Pashov Oct 2024, Trust Security Sep 2024), Votemarket V1 (ChainSecurity Jan 2023), vlSDT (Trust Security Mar 2026), Misc (ChainSecurity Oct 2022, ChainSecurity Feb 2022, Omniscia Mar 2025, Trust Security Aug 2025). Audit PDFs do not contain explicit in-scope address tables extractable from the repo index page; PDF internals not fetched in this run.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/stake-dao has 45 repos including stake-dao/offchain-registry (address-book data source for the docs page) and stake-dao/contracts-monorepo. The docs page is synced from offchain-registry/tree/main/data/address-book. No pinned commit SHA was obtainable in this run from the GitHub page (last commit metadata not loaded). Protocol.github was null in the per-protocol context; confirmed org is https://github.com/stake-dao.

D5: Multi-chain: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Fraxtal, Linea, Optimism, Polygon, Sonic covered in docs. Gnosis, Taiko, BNB/BSC, zkSync Era also present in docs but not in protocol.chains. Avalanche and xDai listed in protocol.chains but ZERO addresses surfaced in the docs address table for those chains — recorded as unknowns.

D6: Multiple factories identified: Curve FACTORY (strategy, per-chain), Balancer FACTORY, Pendle FACTORY, Blackpool none, Frax none. Strategy children (individual vault/strategy contracts) not enumerated — the docs table shows 672 total entries including strategy entries but individual child vault addresses are not broken out in the index. The main Ethereum Curve strategy FACTORY is at 0xEf9bef9AB7b578eb0654F0cD2C75519c9A3f7FE1; Convex sidecar factory at 0x6DFA6232eC23E029d4322115f491a912De9cF9E7. Cap notice: individual strategy child contracts not enumerated (count unknown, >50 likely).

D7: Role taxonomy applied. Key admin addresses: TIMELOCK (timelock), GOVERNANCE (governance/multisig), TREASURY (multisig/unknown), PROXY_ADMIN (proxy_admin), DEPLOYER (eoa/unknown), ALL_MIGHT / ALL_MIGHT_V2 (admin/guardian bots), EXECUTOR_GUARD (guardian). Per-protocol: LOCKER, DEPOSITOR, VOTER, ACCUMULATOR, GAUGE, STRATEGY, FACTORY roles identified across Curve, Balancer, f(x), Frax, Maverick, PancakeSwap, Pendle, Spectra, Yearn, Yield Basis, Yieldnest, Zero, Resolv, Blackpool.
D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched https://docs.stakedao.org/addresses page (index 3). No snippet-only sightings used.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk complete: official docs address registry (672 contracts), audit GitHub repo (11 reports), timelock docs, and bug bounty page all fetched. 18 core/admin addresses catalogued in admin_addresses; the full 672-contract set is represented via deployed_contracts_doc link. Two chains from protocol.chains (Avalanche, xDai) had zero addresses surfaced.

evidence.shows: Official Stake DAO website confirms protocol description: boosted LP strategies via Liquid Lockers (CRV, FXN, YB), vlSDT governance token, Votemarket, and Boost Marketplace. GitHub org @stake-dao, Twitter @StakeDAOHQ.

Audit documentation page: lists audit partners (ChainSecurity, Omniscia, Trust Security, Pashov Audit Group, Zach Obront), links to GitHub audit repo, references Bug Bounty page for vulnerability reporting.

Canonical deployed contracts page: 672 contracts across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BSC, Fraxtal, Gnosis, Linea, Optimism, Polygon, Sonic, Taiko, zkSync Era. Includes core Stake DAO contracts (SDT, VESDT, VLSDT, TIMELOCK at 0xD3cFc4E65a73BB6C482383EB38f5C3E1d1411616, TREASURY at 0x9EBBb3d59d53D6aD3FA5464f36c2E84aBb7cf5c1, PROXY_ADMIN at 0xfE612c237A81527a86f2Cac1FD19939CF4F91B9B, GOVERNANCE at 0xB0552b6860CE5C0202976Db056b5e3Cc4f9CC765, DEPLOYER at 0x000755Fbe4A24d7478bfcFC1E561AfCE82d1ff62), data synced from offchain-registry GitHub.

Audit repository index: 11 audit reports organized by product (staking-v2, onlyboost, votemarket v1/v2/laposte, vlsdt, misc). Auditors: Omniscia, Trust Security, Pashov Audit Group, ChainSecurity, Zach Obront. Most recent: Omniscia Sep 2025 staking v2, Trust Security Mar 2026 vlSDT.

ProtocolTimelock: 48-hour mandatory delay on all protocol changes. Roles: Proposer (governance multisig), Executor (permissionless after delay), Guardian (immediate emergency pause/shutdown), Admin (role management). Emergency functions only pause deposits; withdrawals always remain functional. References Contract Addresses page for deployed timelock addresses.

Self-hosted bug bounty program: in-scope = Ethereum mainnet contracts listed in Contract Addresses + stake-dao GitHub org production contracts. Severity tiers up to $100k (Critical). Security email via Cloudflare-obfuscated address on page (path: [email protected] obfuscated). No Immunefi page linked.
Confirmed stake-dao/offchain-registry repo exists as the canonical address-book source for the docs address page. Contains mapping of protocol/locker/strategy/votemarket addresses across all chains.

protocol_metadata.about: Stake DAO is a DeFi yield protocol that boosts LP yield by accumulating deep governance power through Liquid Lockers — users deposit governance tokens (CRV, FXN, YB) to receive tradable sdTokens while Stake DAO permanently locks the underlying tokens to accumulate veCRV, veFXN, and veYB. This locked voting power is directed toward gauge weights for Boosted Strategies, allowing LP depositors to earn amplified APY without locking tokens themselves. The protocol also offers vlSDT (vote-locked SDT) for protocol governance and fee sharing, Votemarket for on-chain vote-incentive campaigns, and a Boost Marketplace where vlSDT holders can rent gauge-voting boost to sdToken holders. All protocol-critical parameter changes are subject to a 48-hour ProtocolTimelock, and guardians can immediately pause deposits (but not withdrawals) in emergencies.
